newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Colonial Commercial units top turnover.
newsitem.headline: Colonial Commercial units top turnover.

text.p: Units in the Colonial Commercial Property Trust topped turnover lists on Monday with 10.71 million units traded.
The bulk of the business was in two lines through SBC Warburg totalling 10.7 million units, both at A$2.33 per unit, brokers said.
Brokers speculated that financial services group Colonial Ltd had lightened its stake.
However, a Colonial spokesperson was unavailable for comment.
Colonial held 20.51 million units or a 19.91 percent stake in the trust according to the last substantial shareholding notice lodged with the Australian Stock Exchange in April, 1997.
Colonial Commercial Property units closed a cent lower at A$2.38.
